diagnosticContract.spanPolicy: Exact quoted member, unresolved bare name, static member expression, primitive operand, or cast expression span registered per case.
diagnosticContract.suggestionPolicy: EnumValue guidance is valid for explicit numeric inspection of a nominal mismatch; contextual quoted-member guidance is not valid for casts or ordinary strings.

revisionHistory.reason: The first aggregate replay showed that comparing a bare name or static Type.Member directly with a native enum produces recovery plus the intended diagnostic, violating the one-root candidate gate.
NC01 and NC02 now isolate bare and static enum syntax as projection expressions. The expected codes and semantic contract remain unchanged; no production code changed.
The static Type.Member diagnostic was observed on the type alias span JobStatus rather than the complete member expression. Only the registered span oracle changed; no production code changed.
